c0180: What you buy: van, upfit, equipment, launch and formation costs. The cash cushion is not an investment: it is working capital

c0382: 4. All figures are EXCL. SALES TAX. To turn a quoted price into a price excl. sales tax, divide it by 1 + your sales tax rate (with an 8% rate, divide by 1.08); if an item is taxed at a different rate in your state, use that rate. In many states the whole catering invoice is taxable, including staff and rentals; check yours. The rate of each sales line is in the "Sales tax rate on the line (%)" column of the P&L, and from it come the receipts, the sales tax collected and the equivalent price per guest incl. sales tax. With the default 0% recoverable input tax, the sales tax you pay on purchases and startup costs is treated as a cost; in the UK, enter 20% if you are VAT-registered.
c0597: The same calculation on what you BUY (van, upfit, equipment, launch and formation costs), without working capital: that money is not spent, it is tied up and comes back when the business closes. For reference only: the payback that matters is the one above
c0958: Each tab's counter counts only the ✓; N/A items come out of the total.
